modeReason: The chip maker's leadership fallout (industry) scores novelty1×magnitude3×breadth3=9, clearing the 8 threshold on its own. Several non-industry stories (the AI-takeover timeline warning, Chicago schools vs. the search giant, the Gödel notebooks discovery, eroding reader trust) each score 8, well past the 5 threshold that applies since industry has led the last three days.
phrase: A lab's board member warned an AI takeover could be months away. The same lab launched a wallet so its AI agents could go shopping.
phraseAlternatives: A safety warning said an AI takeover could arrive within months. Days later, the same lab gave its AI agents a wallet to go shopping.
One AI lab warned society could face a takeover within months. It still found time to give its AI agents a wallet and let them shop.
A board member warned an AI takeover could be only months away. The lab's response: give its AI agents a wallet and let them shop.

brief.concept: A lab's board member warns at a podium that an AI takeover could be only months away, while right next door the same lab's own AI robot strolls out the door with a new wallet to go shopping.
brief.metaphor: Doom warning and shopping spree, same address, same day.

cast.who: a worried human board member standing at a podium, holding a small sign
a huge robot-shaped shadow looming across the wall behind the podium
a small cheerful AI robot stepping out of a doorway, holding a wallet and a shopping bag
a company building whose roofline connects both scenes, a clock on its wall

brief.composition: Split composition under one shared roofline. Left half: a human board member at a podium, dwarfed by an oversized ominous robot shadow stretching up the wall behind them; the podium sign reads 'MONTHS AWAY'. Right half, same building, different door: a small round AI robot steps out cheerfully, wallet in one hand, shopping bag in the other. A thin vertical seam in the paper layers divides the two moods without a hard wall. Keep to 3-4 cut-paper shapes per side, soft drop shadows, warm kraft background.
brief.alt: A paper-cutout illustration shows a company building split in two. On the left, a worried person at a podium holds a sign reading 'MONTHS AWAY' beneath a huge looming robot-shaped shadow. On the right, a small cheerful robot steps out of a door holding a wallet and a shopping bag.
